lead_headline: Denver restaurants churn Monday: Call Your Mother opens Union Station bagel shop while Challengers Sports Bar and Falafel King shutter after years-long runs

restaurant.blurb: 3 leads today: Call Your Mother opens Union Station, Challengers Sports Bar (Aurora) and Falafel King (Congress Park) close. Active: 172 openings, 166 closures.

liquor.blurb: 2 new applications today: Two Hands (hotel/restaurant, Milwaukee St) and Colorado Blvd Fastbreak join pending queue. 2 status flips — Stoney's Bar & Grill (Raleigh) turns delinquent while Ariat (Larimer) clears back to active. Week finishes at 7 applications vs. 271 prior — post-anomaly processing normalizes as administrative teams clear Wednesday's 267-filing backlog and return to baseline application flow.

reputation.blurb: Zero mentions Monday pushes citation drought to 13 consecutive days — longest void on record with no pickups since August 4. Zero active sources. All-time total frozen at 1,167 mentions (111 sources lifetime). Past 30 days: 104 mentions vs. typical 70-90 weekly baseline. Thirteen-day freeze now unprecedented territory, eclipsing all prior holiday gaps — points to sustained syndication failure or monitoring outage rather than normal editorial cycle variance.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +12 yesterday (13 new, 1 canceled) as Sunday acquisition surge continues post-weekend momentum. MTD improves to −3 (−0.2/day) while 90-day net climbs to +74. Past 7 days: +19 net (33 new, 14 canceled) vs. prior week's −19 — sharp reversal driven by sustained low churn (14 vs. 41 cancellations) and steady new-subscriber flow. Weekend strength real: Sunday's 13-new performance matches Thursday/Wednesday acquisition spikes. August MTD drag narrows toward breakeven as weekly momentum builds — cancellation discipline holds while sporadic new bursts suggest stabilization gaining traction.
